subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work in 8 days of 5 hours each, and B can do it in 7 days of 9 hours each. How long will they take to complete the work, working together (24)/(5) hours a day?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total time A = 8 × 5 = 40 hrs; Total time B = 7 × 9 = 63 hrs.

Combined time = (40 × 63) ÷ (40 + 63) = 2520/103 hrs.

Days = Combined time ÷ Hours per day = (2520/103) ÷ (24/5).

Days = (2520 × 5) ÷ (103 × 24) = 105 × 5 / 103 = 525/103.

525/103 = 5¹⁰/₁₀₃ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5¹⁰/₁₀₃ days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A can complete the work in 8 days working 5 hours a day.

B can complete the work in 7 days working 9 hours a day.

Working hours per day together = 24/5 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total time taken by A in hours = 8 × 5 = 40 hours.

⇒ Total time taken by B in hours = 7 × 9 = 63 hours.

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and B = 63 + 40 = 103 units/hr.

⇒ Total time required to finish the work together = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 2520 / 103 hours.

⇒ Number of days required = Total time ÷ Hours per day

⇒ Number of days = (2520 / 103) ÷ (24 / 5)

⇒ Number of days = (2520 × 5) / (103 × 24)

⇒ Number of days = 105 × 5 / 103

⇒ Number of days = 525 / 103

⇒ 525 / 103 = 5¹⁰/₁₀₃ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5¹⁰/₁₀₃ days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Works on the same concept as Time & Work, but an inlet pipe has positive efficiency while an outlet pipe has negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in proportion to the total work done by each individual. If workers work for the same duration, wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When people work on alternate days, find the work completed in a cycle of 2 days, multiply to get close to total work, and then assign the remaining work to the first person whose turn is next.
